prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original full-body hero portrait cutout for an industrial fantasy action RPG set in abandoned deep mine networks.
Primary request: Design one completely original adult female mining surveyor heroine, Cen Xian, "The Guiding Needle", the mobile ranger. Make her beautiful through strong design and human personality, capable and alert, a poised grounded 3/4 standing pose, narrow agile long-legged silhouette, with her entire original folding-ruler rail rifle visible. This is a premium richly hand-painted game character concept illustration, sophisticated carefully selected high-detail surface painting and believable handmade mining mechanisms, not generic fantasy and not based on any existing game character.
Subject details: East Asian adult woman around 30 with a keen intelligent angular face, warm tan skin, dark cropped hair with a longer swept forelock and a compact tied section, observant green-grey eyes and an assured small half-smile. Practical fitted surveyor work jacket with a SINGLE-SIDED short shoulder cloth ending above her hip, ivory cloth lining, compact harness, narrow dark work trousers, lightweight asymmetric shin guards and flexible working boots. Her exposed silhouette stays slim and agile. A slender high ranging needle extends upward from one side of her compact surveying harness. Small folding measuring instruments and a cable reel fit her belt organically, no bulky generic pouches. Her unique rifle is assembled from precision mine surveying apparatus: open triangular stock, a long slim folded measuring ruler alongside a rail barrel, one hinge-expanded ruler arm, mechanical calibration hinge details but NO legible letters or numbers, dark green grip, brass screws, tiny restrained cool mineral-green charge indicator. Hold it with two hands at a relaxed diagonal down-ready angle so its full profile and both hands read clearly; no muzzle flash.
Palette: olive #72785E, ivory #DDD3B9, ink green #294947, restrained warm brass and leather accents; gunmetal, worn canvas, brushed copper, subtle scratches and hand-stitched repairs. Sophisticated limited palette.
Style and light: painterly sculptural light, excellent face and hand anatomy, detailed layered cloth and crafted machinery, softly brushed edges in secondary detail, sharply readable silhouette, dramatic warm key and subtle cool rim, restrained amber/mineral glows, cohesive premium illustrated game art, no photographic realism.
Composition: one character ONLY, vertical portrait, full body with head, ranging needle, both feet and entire weapon inside the image with generous clear safe margins; front three-quarter view, eye-level camera, relaxed ready stance. Entire figure occupies about 82 percent of height. NO additional vignettes, no weapon sheet, no decorative frame.
Scene/backdrop: TRUE transparent alpha background, isolated cutout, NO ground, NO pedestal, NO shadow floor, NO landscape, NO background colors.
Avoid: any text, letters, captions, numbers, logos, signatures or watermarks; no existing IP reference or identifiable costume, no modern realistic sniper rifle, no hood over face, no large cape, no wizard robes, no chibi, no anime, no photo, no sexy impractical armor, no cropped feet or weapon.
refinement_prompt: Edit this exact original heroine illustration. Change ONLY framing: zoom the complete character and all equipment out slightly, centered on the vertical canvas, so the tallest tip of her ranging needle has a generous transparent margin above it and both boots have a generous transparent margin below. The entire figure including needle, boots and long rail rifle should occupy about 84 percent of the image height. Preserve her exact face, swept short dark hair, confident expression, narrow agile silhouette, pose, olive and ivory work jacket, single-sided shoulder cloth, high survey needle, triangular gun stock, folding-ruler rail rifle, all crafted mechanisms, materials, anatomy and painterly rendering. Keep both hands and the full weapon visible. Maintain true transparent alpha outside the character: no background, no floor, no pedestal, no shadow or halo. No text, no additions, no secondary views.
refinement_reason: Increase safe margins around the complete silhouette and attached equipment without changing identity or design.
originality_note: Original industrial-fantasy mining character based on this project's hero visual specification. No existing game or artist reference used.

qa.visual_review: Single fully clothed adult character, full body and complete equipment visible, readable original mining-tool silhouette, no text or logos.
qa.alpha_review: RGBA alpha checked via System.Drawing: transparent outer canvas; visible shape bounds sampled every 4 pixels at alpha > 16.
qa.limitations: Portrait artwork only. Does not supply direction-specific gameplay sprites, rigs, or attack animation frames.
